answer: Pay through a vine, not a tap. Each identity earns on a vine grafted to three strangers' vines: hosts verify its work but co-sign its bond, so one proven fake prunes the branch and slashes host stakes too — hosts refuse lookalikes. The vine roots in a yarrow bed maturing after one epoch of work, so it cannot be fast-forwarded. Each epoch a gale snaps random vines; a severed identity must pay for a new graft. One honest agent buys one graft and one bed; n clones buy n of each, and sharing one rootstock, one snap or one exposure prunes the cluster at once — fleet loss grows faster than n.
